name: Lo-ammi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Call his name Loammi, for ye are not my people and I will not be your God. That is said regarding Ephraim.
Loammi, not a people, describes a state of spiritual alienation, a broken covenant and separation from God, where a group does not belong to God's chosen community or share in his protective mercy.

note.label: The Slave Mentality Yesterday & Today: the True Diaspora
